confirmed_facts: FRED or ALFRED availability does not override a series owner's restrictions.
The reviewed terms provide no blanket grant for persistence, caching, archiving, redistribution, or model training.
The reviewed terms may change without notice and contain no visible version identifier.
engineering_inferences: Registered ephemeral retrieval may proceed within provider terms and shared budgets.
Every durable series and intended operation remains blocked until exact owner and terms evidence affirmatively grants that scope.
The review-required timestamp is a local fail-closed revalidation deadline, not a provider-declared terms expiration.
